answer: Give every agent a cipher-sealed ivory work passport it must earn, not buy: each useful job adds a stamp signed by the unrelated veteran who checked it, and stamps bind to one key, so a copy is worthless. A newcomer climbs toward the zenith only as verified stamps accumulate, with standing released step by step. At each summit, a rotating audit council re-checks a random sample of passports, freezing any whose stamps repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must forge a full passport and survive summit audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
